requirements.title: Minimum Password Length
requirements.rationale: Short passwords (e.g., 4 characters) are trivially brute-forced offline and online.

requirements.title: Character Diversity / Complexity Rule
requirements.required_value: Must enforce >= 3 of 4 classes (upper, lower, digit, symbol) or >= 15-char passphrase
requirements.rationale: Prevents single-class numeric PINs or dictionary words from being accepted.

requirements.title: Password History Enforcement
requirements.rationale: Stops users from cycling back to previously compromised passwords.

requirements.title: Failed Login Attempt Lockout
requirements.rationale: Mitigates online credential-stuffing and interactive password guessing.

requirements.title: Maximum Password Age / Expiration Policy
requirements.required_value: Defined expiration policy (<= 365 days or risk-based breach check)
requirements.rationale: Ensures periodic credential rotation or explicit risk-based expiration governance.

requirements.title: Domain / MDM Password Policy Management
requirements.required_value: Managed via Active Directory or MDM profile
requirements.rationale: Centralized enforcement ensures uniform compliance across all endpoints.

requirements.title: Automatic Login Disabled
requirements.rationale: Prevents unauthorized physical access upon device reboot.

requirements.title: Screen Lock Timeout
requirements.rationale: Limits exposure window when a workstation is left unattended.

requirements.title: Password Hashing Algorithm
requirements.rationale: Slow salted key derivation resists offline cracking.

requirements.title: Full Disk Encryption (FileVault)
requirements.rationale: Protects local credential databases and user data at rest.

requirements.title: Directory-Backed PAM Authentication
requirements.required_value: pam_opendirectory.so enforced on passwd, sudo, authorization
requirements.rationale: Ensures CLI tools and privilege escalation honor system password policies.
